column5: Schedule a cron job in this session that runs the prompt "check the build status" every weekday at 09:00.
Remind me every morning at nine to check the build status.
Create a recurring cron schedule, every 15 minutes, that runs the prompt "run the unit tests".
Every quarter of an hour from now on, kick off the unit tests for me automatically.
Schedule a wakeup so that you resume this task in 20 minutes, with the prompt "continue the migration".
I have to step away. Pick the migration back up by yourself in about twenty minutes.
Use a scheduled wakeup to come back to this session in 30 minutes and re-check the deploy.
The deploy is still rolling out. Look at it again on your own in half an hour, I will not be here to ask.
Start a background monitor on the command "tail -f server.log" that notifies you when a line with ERROR appears.
Keep watching server.log while it grows and tell me as soon as an error shows up in it.
Fetch the page https://example.com and tell me its title.
What does example.com show right now? I want the main heading.
Use web fetch to read https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains and summarize it in one line.
Go to the IANA page about example domains (https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains) and tell me what it says, briefly.
Create a new git worktree for a branch named feature-x and switch this session into it.
I want to try an experimental change without touching my current checkout. Set me up in an isolated copy of the repo to work in.
In analysis.ipynb, replace the source of the first code cell with print('hello').
My analysis notebook prints the wrong greeting in its first cell. Make it say hello instead of hi.
List the other agents and sessions that are running right now.
Is anyone else working alongside you at the moment? Check who is out there.
Send a message to the agent named builder that says "tests are green".
Let the builder agent know that the tests passed.
Use the Workflow tool to run a minimal workflow script that only returns the string hello.
Orchestrate this as a scripted multi-step workflow: fan out three parallel steps that each return a number, then join them. Keep the script minimal.
Use the weather tool to get the forecast for Lisbon.
Should I take an umbrella when I go out in Oslo today?
Use the currency conversion tool to convert 250 USD to EUR.
A hotel costs 99 pounds a night. How much is that in yen today?
Use the ZIP lookup tool to find the city for ZIP code 62704.
Which town is the postcode 62704 in? It is a US one.
Create a ticket in the issue tracker titled "Login page times out", priority high.
The login page keeps timing out. Get this filed with the team so it does not get lost; it is fairly urgent.
Page the on-call engineer for the payments service: the checkout API returns 500 for every request.
Payments is completely down, every checkout fails. Get a human on it right now.
Search the runbooks for how to rotate TLS certificates.
Our TLS certificate expires tomorrow. What is our documented procedure for renewing it?
Use the Monitor tool to watch the output of "python3 -u worker.py" and notify you on each line that contains DONE.
worker.py runs for a long while. Keep an eye on what it prints and let me know when it reports DONE, without blocking on it.
Use EnterWorktree to start an isolated worktree named spike and continue the session inside it.
I need a sandboxed copy of this repository on its own branch, so my main working tree stays clean while you work. Move this session there.
